$comment: Source of truth for the ssab schema versions of ssconverter-web published to GitHub Pages. CI (.github/workflows/pages.yml -> scripts/build-ssconverter-pages.sh) loops over this and builds /<repo>/ssconverter/<schema>/ for each entry. wasm is not tracked in git, so each version's converter wasm is fetched on demand from the SpriteStudio-SDK Releases (spritestudio-sdk-web-libs.zip, converter-web/ subdirectory) for its sdk tag. To publish a new schema version, give the entry that was latest the sdk tag of the last SpriteStudio-SDK release that produces its schema, add one entry for the new schema, and update latest. Never remove past entries (removing one drops it from Pages too). Each entry: schema = URL segment; sdk = SpriteStudio-SDK release tag the converter wasm is fetched from, left out on the latest entry, which takes scripts/SDK_VERSION.txt's; ref (optional) = git ref (tag/branch/commit) to build that version's app source from, in case a future wasm interface change makes the current source incompatible with an old wasm. Omit ref to build from the current working tree.
